title: Luxury Perfume Product Photography
description: A premium still life of a generic glass perfume bottle on dark stone, with a single sweeping highlight and a gold accent. Intended for advertising concepts and mood boards, never as a depiction of a real branded product.
promptText: Luxury product photograph of a minimalist rectangular glass perfume bottle with a brushed gold cap and no visible branding or text, placed on a polished black marble surface with a faint reflection beneath it. Dark charcoal background fading to black, a single long softbox strip light from the left creating a clean vertical highlight along the glass edge, a subtle warm rim light from behind. A few water droplets on the marble, a single dried flower stem lying nearby, soft shadows. 100mm macro lens, aperture f/8, razor-sharp detail, rich contrast, deep blacks with warm gold highlights. Vertical 4:5 composition, bottle slightly left of centre, generous dark space on the right.
imageAlt: Glass perfume bottle with a gold cap on black marble with a sharp light strip highlight
visualNotes: Glass is shot with a long strip of light that gets reflected as a clean vertical line, which defines the edges against a dark background. Specifying 'no visible branding or text' avoids the garbled lettering that generated bottles often have.

customize.lighting: Ask for 'two strip lights, one each side' for symmetrical edge highlights, or 'single overhead softbox' for a gentler reflection on the top surface.
customize.camera: A 70mm lens at a slightly lower angle makes the bottle feel taller and more monumental; a top-down angle suits flat lay arrangements.
customize.background: A deep green velvet, a stone slab or a warm beige plaster wall each shift the brand mood. Keep the surface simple.
customize.wardrobe: Replace clothing with materials: swap the gold cap for chrome, wood or matte black to change the product positioning.
customize.mood: For a fresher, summery look use 'pale blue backdrop, bright daylight and a splash of water'.
customize.composition: Leave the right-hand dark space empty if you plan to add a product name or tagline in your own design software.
customize.aspectRatio: 4:5 for social ads, 1:1 for marketplace tiles, 16:9 for web banners.

title: Minimalist Product Advertisement
description: A bright, pastel product ad concept: a plain ceramic mug on a coloured plinth with a hard sunlight shadow. Clean shapes and negative space make it easy to add your own copy and brand.
promptText: Minimalist advertising photograph of a plain matte white ceramic mug standing on a pale peach cylindrical plinth against a soft sage-green seamless backdrop, with a thin curl of steam rising from the mug. Hard sunlight from the upper left casting a crisp, elongated shadow of the mug and plinth across the backdrop. Clean geometric composition, subtle paper-like texture on the backdrop, no text and no logos. 90mm lens, aperture f/8, accurate pastel colours, gentle contrast, crisp edges. Square 1:1 composition, product centred low in the frame, large empty space above for a headline.
imageAlt: White ceramic mug on a peach plinth against a sage green backdrop with a hard shadow
visualNotes: Hard light is not a mistake here: the sharp shadow becomes a graphic element that doubles the shape of the product. Using three flat colours (white, peach, sage) keeps the image simple enough to carry a headline in the empty space.

customize.lighting: For a softer, calmer version use 'diffused window light, soft-edged shadow'. For stronger drama, move the sun lower for a longer shadow.
customize.camera: Raise the camera slightly for a more catalogue-like angle, or go top-down for a flat lay with the shadow falling to one side.
customize.background: Try dusty blue, terracotta or butter yellow. Keep the plinth a soft contrasting colour.
customize.wardrobe: Swap the mug for a bottle, a candle or a pair of sunglasses; keep the same set to build a consistent range of images.
customize.mood: Add 'a single small plant sprig beside the plinth' for a softer, more natural feel.
customize.composition: The empty space above is for your text. For a vertical story ad, request 9:16 with the product in the lower third.
customize.aspectRatio: 1:1 for feed ads, 4:5 for portrait posts, 9:16 for stories.

title: Lifestyle Coffee Flat Lay
description: A top-down breakfast-table scene with coffee, a notebook and warm morning light. It is meant for blog headers, café menus and social posts that need a relaxed lifestyle feel rather than a strict product shot.
promptText: Top-down flat lay photograph of a rustic wooden table with a ceramic cup of black coffee on a small saucer, an open notebook with a pen, a croissant on a linen napkin and a small bunch of dried lavender. Soft warm morning light from a window on the left casting gentle, elongated shadows. Natural textures: worn wood grain, creased linen, flaky pastry. 35mm lens shot from directly above, aperture f/5.6, warm natural colours, shallow contrast, cosy and calm atmosphere. Horizontal 3:2 composition, objects arranged loosely along a diagonal, space on the right for text.
imageAlt: Top-down view of a coffee cup, notebook and croissant on a wooden table in morning light
visualNotes: Flat lays are about arrangement. A loose diagonal leads the eye across the frame, and mixing textures (wood, linen, pastry) prevents the scene from looking flat. Window light from the side keeps shadows long enough to give depth.

customize.lighting: For a moodier café feel use 'late afternoon light, deeper shadows and warm lamp glow'.
customize.camera: Shoot at 45 degrees instead of top-down for a more natural 'table view' with depth of field.
customize.background: Replace wood with a marble café table, a concrete counter or a picnic blanket outdoors.
customize.wardrobe: Add hands: 'a hand holding the cup' adds a human touch that suits lifestyle storytelling.
customize.mood: For a bright summer look use 'iced coffee in a tall glass, citrus slice, bright midday light'.
customize.composition: Keep the empty area on the right to hold a menu or title; centre everything for a symmetrical, catalogue-style layout.
customize.aspectRatio: 3:2 for blog headers, 4:5 for feeds, 1:1 for marketplace tiles.
